18200.meaning1: of such a view; who holds the view that; having a theory that

examples.text: evam'eva kho, poṭṭhapāda, ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino, ek'antasukhī attā hoti arogo paraṃ maraṇā'ti.

evaṃvādino, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evam'assu vacanīyā, yasmiṃ, āvuso, samaye līnaṃ cittaṃ hoti, katamesaṃ tasmiṃ samaye bojjh'aṅgānaṃ akālo bhāvanāya, katamesaṃ tasmiṃ samaye bojjh'aṅgānaṃ kālo bhāvanāya?

18201.meaning1: having such consciousness; with this kind of awareness
18201.commentary: (MNa) taṃsampayuttānaṃ'y'eva saññ'ādīnaṃ vasena evaṃsañño evaṃsaṅkhāro evaṃviññāṇo ahosiṃ atītam'addhānan'ti.

examples.text: evaṃsañño siyaṃ anāgatam'addhānaṃ, evaṃsaṅkhāro siyaṃ anāgatam'addhānaṃ, evaṃviññāṇo siyaṃ anāgatam'addhānan'ti. evaṃ kho, gahapati, purakkharāno hoti.
evaṃsaṅkhāro ahosiṃ atītam'addhānan'ti tattha nandiṃ samanvāneti, evaṃviññāṇo ahosiṃ atītam'addhānan'ti tattha nandiṃ samanvāneti, evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, atītaṃ anvāgameti.

18203.meaning1: having such consequences; with such a result
18203.meaning2: having such consequences; with such a result

examples.text: te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ… evaṃvipākaṃ nakkhattānaṃ pathagamanaṃ bhavissati, evaṃvipākaṃ nakkhattānaṃ uppathagamanaṃ bhavissati, evaṃvipāko ukkāpāto bhavissati

18204.meaning1: liberated in such a way; thus freed
18204.commentary: (MNa) evaṃvimuttā'ti ettha vikkhambhanavimutti tadaṅgavimutti samucchedavimutti paṭippassaddhivimutti nissaraṇavimuttī'ti pañcavidhā vimuttiyo. tattha aṭṭha samāpattiyo sayaṃ vikkhambhitehi nīvaraṇ'ādīhi vimuttattā vikkhambhanavimuttī'ti saṅkhaṃ gacchanti. anicc'ānupassan'ādikā satta anupassanā sayaṃ tassa tassa paccanīk'aṅgavasena paricattāhi niccasaññ'ādīhi vimuttattā tadaṅgavimuttī'ti saṅkhaṃ gacchanti. cattāro ariyamaggā sayaṃ samucchinnehi kilesehi vimuttattā samucchedavimuttī'ti saṅkhaṃ gacchanti. cattāri sāmaññaphalāni magg'ānubhāvena kilesānaṃ paṭippassaddh'ante uppannattā paṭippassaddhivimuttī'ti saṅkhaṃ gacchanti. nibbānaṃ sabbakilesehi nissaṭattā apagatattā dūre ṭhitattā nissaraṇavimuttī'ti saṅkhaṃ gataṃ. iti imāsaṃ pañcannaṃ vimuttīnaṃ vasena evaṃvimuttā'ti evam'ettha attho veditabbo.

examples.text: so kho pan'assa āyasmā sāmaṃ diṭṭho vā hoti anussavassuto vā, evaṃsīlo so āyasmā ahosi iti'pi, evaṃdhammo so āyasmā ahosi iti'pi, evaṃpañño so āyasmā ahosi iti'pi, evaṃvihārī so āyasmā ahosi iti'pi, evaṃvimutto so āyasmā ahosi iti'pī'ti.

18205.meaning1: with mind liberated in such a way; with such kind of emancipated heart

examples.text: vidhūpetvā ṭhito evaṃvimuttacittaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuṃ saindā devā sabrahmakā sapajāpatikā ārakā'va namassanti

18206.meaning1: who lives in this way; living like this

examples.text: evaṃvihārī sato appamatto, bhikkhu caraṃ hitvā mamāyitāni, jātiṃ jaraṃ sokapariddavañ'ca, idh'eva vidvā pajaheyya dukkhaṃ.

18207.meaning1: arranged in this way; fashioned thus; so formed

examples.text: ye pana mayaṃ ahumhā tena bhotā brahmunā nimmitā, te mayaṃ aniccā addhuvā app'āyukā cavanadhammā itthattaṃ āgatā'ti. evaṃvihitakaṃ no tumhe āyasmanto issarakuttaṃ brahmakuttaṃ ācariyakaṃ aggaññaṃ paññapethā'ti.

18208.meaning1: having such feeling; having this kind of sensation

examples.text: kathañ'ca, gahapati, purakkharāno hoti? idha, gahapati, ekaccassa evaṃ hoti, evaṃrūpo siyaṃ anāgatam'addhānaṃ, evaṃvedano siyaṃ anāgatam'addhānaṃ
evaṃrūpo ahosiṃ atītam'addhānan'ti tattha nandiṃ samanvāneti, evaṃvedano ahosiṃ atītam'addhānan'ti tattha nandiṃ samanvāneti, evaṃsañño ahosiṃ atītam'addhānan'ti tattha nandiṃ samanvāneti

18209.meaning1: of such behaviour; with such conduct
18209.meaning2: of such behaviour, of such conduct

examples.text: anekehi sambhārehi samāraddhā vadati, seyyath'idaṃ, doṇiñ'ca paṭicca cammañ'ca paṭicca daṇḍañ'ca paṭicca upadhāraṇe ca paṭicca tantiyo ca paṭicca koṇañ'ca paṭicca purisassa ca tajjaṃ vāyāmaṃ paṭicca ev'āyaṃ, bhante, vīṇā nāma anekasambhārā mahāsambhārā.
aho vat'āyaṃ samīti yānakāraputto imissā nemiyā imañ'ca vaṅkaṃ imañ'ca jimhaṃ imañ'ca dosaṃ taccheyya, ev'āyaṃ nemi apagatavaṅkā apagatajimhā apagatadosā suddhā assa sāre patiṭṭhitā'ti.
aññāya ca pan'āhaṃ samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtikānaṃ dhammaṃ ev'āhaṃ tasmā dhammavinayā apakkanto'ti.
ev'āhaṃ cintayitvāna, n'ekakoṭisataṃ dhanaṃ, nāth'ānāthānaṃ datvāna, himavantam'upāgamiṃ.
tatr'āp'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, n'eva āgatiṃ vadāmi, na gatiṃ, na ṭhitiṃ, na cutiṃ, na upapattiṃ. appatiṭṭhaṃ, appavattaṃ, anārammaṇam'ev'etaṃ. es'ev'anto dukkhassā'ti.
yā c'eva kho pana ajjhattikā pathavīdhātu yā ca bāhirā pathavīdhātu, pathavīdhātu'r'ev'esā.

18214.meaning1: come now!; hey come!; come on!

examples.text: tam'enaṃ tvaṃ evaṃ vadeyyāsi, eh'ambho purisa, ayaṃ maggo rājagahaṃ gacchati. tena muhuttaṃ gaccha, tena muhuttaṃ gantvā dakkhissasi amukaṃ nāma gāmaṃ
eh'ambho purisa, yaṃ jānāsi taṃ vadehī'ti. so ajānaṃ vā āha, jānāmī'ti, jānaṃ vā āha, na jānāmī'ti, apassaṃ vā āha, passāmī'ti, passaṃ vā āha, na passāmī'ti.
yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ, eh'āvuso, gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisissāmā'ti tassa dāpetvā vā adāpetvā vā uyyojeyya, gacch'āvuso, na me tayā saddhiṃ kathā vā nisajjā vā phāsu hoti
atha kho bhagavā aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantesi, ehi tvaṃ, bhikkhu, mama vacanena theraṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantehi, satthā taṃ, āvuso thera, āmantetī'ti.

tam'enaṃ mitt'āmaccā ñātisālohitā jātam'eva naṃ saṅghāṭikaṃ kareyyuṃ, saṅghāṭikattam'eva samādapeyyuṃ, ehi tvaṃ, bhadramukha, saṅghāṭiko hohi, saṅghāṭikassa te sato saṅghāṭidhāraṇamattena abhijjhālussa abhijjhā pahīyissati

18217.commentary: (ANa) ehi tvan'ti there paṭibaddhacittā taṃ pahiṇituṃ evam'āha.

examples.text: ehi tvaṃ, bhikkhu, sīlavā hohi, pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharāhi ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī, samādāya sikkhassu sikkhāpadesū'ti

18218.commentary: (JAa) tadā ehinti me vasan'ti tasmiṃ kāle sabbe'pi te mama vasaṃ āgacchissanti. ath'āhaṃ te gahetvā tava mukhaṃ hāsento āgacchissāmīti bhariyaṃ samassāsesi.

examples.text: sammodamānā gacchanti, jālamādāya pakkhino, yadā te vivadissanti, tadā ehinti me vasan'ti.
sammodamānā gacchanti, jālamādāya pakkhino, yadā te vivadissanti, tadā ehinti me vasan'ti.

18220.meaning1: open to inspection; inviting to come and see for oneself; verifiable
18220.meaning2: that which invites every man to come and see, open to all
18220.commentary: (SNa) yo ettha ariyamaggadhammo, so attano pavattisamanantaram'eva phalaṃ detī'ti attho. ehi passa imaṃ dhamman'ti evaṃ pavattaṃ ehipassavidhiṃ arahatī'ti ehipassiko

examples.text: dhamme aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti, svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo sandiṭṭhiko akāliko ehipassiko opaneyyiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhī'ti
so navañ'ca kammaṃ na karoti, purāṇañ'ca kammaṃ phussa phussa byantīkaroti, sandiṭṭhikā nijjarā akālikā ehipassikā opaneyyikā paccattaṃ veditabbā viññūhi.

18221.meaning2: (one) who accepts an invitation (to take alms)
18221.commentary: (ANa) bhikkhāya gahaṇ'atthaṃ ehi, bhadante'ti vutto na etī'ti na ehibhadantiko. tena hi tiṭṭha, bhante'ti vutto'pi na tiṭṭhatī'ti na tiṭṭhabhadantiko.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco acelako hoti mutt'ācāro, hatth'āpalekhano hatth'āvalekhano, na ehibhadantiko, na tiṭṭhabhadantiko, n'ābhihaṭaṃ na uddissakataṃ na nimantanaṃ sādiyati.

18222.commentary: (MNa) bhikkhāgahaṇ'atthaṃ ehi bhaddante'ti vutto na etī'ti na ehibhaddantiko.

examples.text: tatrāssu me idaṃ, sāriputta, tapassitāya hoti, acelako homi mutt'ācāro hatth'āpalekhano, na ehibhaddantiko na tiṭṭhabhaddantiko

18223.meaning2: (the oldest formula of admission to the community), come O monk

18224.meaning2: one ordained by the formula 'come nun!'

18226.meaning1: you will go; you will come (to)

examples.text: siñca bhikkhu imaṃ nāvaṃ, sittā te lahum'essati, chetvā rāgañ'ca dosañ'ca, tato nibbānam'ehisi.

18227.meaning1: saying 'come, you are welcome'; welcoming; hospitable
18227.commentary: (DNa) ehi svāgatavādī'ti devamanussa-pabbajita-gahaṭṭhesu taṃ taṃ attano santikaṃ āgataṃ, ehi svāgatan'ti evaṃ vadatī'ti attho.

examples.text: samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo ehisvāgatavādī sakhilo sammodako abbhākuṭiko uttānamukho pubbabhāsī…
seyyathā'pi nāma balavā puriso dīghalomikaṃ eḷakaṃ lomesu gahetvā ākaḍḍheyya parikaḍḍheyya samparikaḍḍheyya, evam'ev'āhaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ vādena vādaṃ ākaḍḍhissāmi parikaḍḍhissāmi samparikaḍḍhissāmi.
bhante pubbe dīpino eḷake khādanti ahaṃ pana eḷake dīpino anubandhitvā murumurū'ti khādante addasaṃ

18230.commentary: (DNa) na eḷakam'antaran'ti ummāraṃ antaraṃ katvā diyyamānaṃ na gaṇhati. kasmā? ayaṃ maṃ nissāya antarakaraṇaṃ labhatī'ti. daṇḍamusalesu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: te na kumbhimukhā paṭiggaṇhanti na kaḷopimukhā paṭiggaṇhanti na eḷakam'antaraṃ na daṇḍam'antaraṃ na musalam'antaraṃ na dvinnaṃ bhuñjamānānaṃ na gabbhiniyā na pāyamānāya na puris'antaragatāya

18232.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of eḷakamantara
18232.meaning1: inside a doorway; across a threshold
18232.commentary: (DNa) na eḷakam'antaran'ti ummāraṃ antaraṃ katvā diyyamānaṃ na gaṇhati. kasmā? ayaṃ maṃ nissāya antarakaraṇaṃ labhatī'ti. daṇḍamusalesu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: te na kumbhimukhā paṭiggaṇhanti na kaḷopimukhā paṭiggaṇhanti na eḷakam'antaraṃ na daṇḍam'antaraṃ na musalam'antaraṃ na dvinnaṃ bhuñjamānānaṃ na gabbhiniyā na pāyamānāya na puris'antaragatāya
yo pana bhikkhu suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ santhataṃ kārāpeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
bhikkhuno pan'eva addhānamaggappaṭipannassa eḷakalomāni uppajjeyyuṃ, ākaṅkhamānena bhikkhunā paṭiggahetabbāni, paṭiggahetvā tiyojanaparamaṃ sahatthā haritabbāni asante hārake.

18234.meaning1: rule about making wash goats' fleece; Nissaggiya 17

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ santhataṃ kārāpeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
na pādā na visāṇena, n'āssu hiṃsanti kenaci, gāvo eḷakasamānā, soratā kumbhadūhanā, tā visāṇe gahetvāna, rājā satthena ghātayi.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, dīghalomikā eḷakā kaṇṭakagahanaṃ paviseyya. sā tatra tatra sajjeyya, tatra tatra gayheyya, tatra tatra bajjheyya, tatra tatra anayabyasanaṃ āpajjeyya.
k'āyaṃ eḷagalāgumbe, karoti ahuhāsiyaṃ, na'y'idha naccaṃ vā gītaṃ vā, tāḷaṃ vā susamāhitaṃ, anamhikāle sussoṇi, kiṃ nu jagghasi sobhaṇe.

18244.commentary: (MNa) elaṇḍehī'ti elaṇḍā kira sāladūsanā honti, tasmā evam'āha

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, gāmassa vā nigamassa vā avidūre mahantaṃ sālavanaṃ. tañ'c'assa eḷaṇḍehi sañchannaṃ.

18246.commentary: (MNa) eḷamūgā'ti elamukhā, kha-kārassa ga-kāro kato. lālamukhā'ti vuttaṃ hoti. duppaññānañ'hi kathentānaṃ lālā mukhato galati, lālā ca elā'ti vuccati.

examples.text: ye'me, bho gotama, puggalā… kusītā hīnavīriyā muṭṭhassatino asampajānā asamāhitā vibbhantacittā duppaññā eḷamūgā, na tehi bhavaṃ gotamo saddhiṃ saṃvasati.
ye kho keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā duppaññā eḷamūgā araññavanapatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni paṭisevanti, duppaññaeḷamūgasandosahetu have te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā akusalaṃ bhayabheravaṃ avhāyanti.
ye'me, bho gotama, puggalā… kusītā hīnavīriyā muṭṭhassatino asampajānā asamāhitā vibbhantacittā duppaññā eḷamūgā, na tehi bhavaṃ gotamo saddhiṃ saṃvasati.

ime'pi rañño eḷeyyassa parihārakā bālā, yamako moggallo uggo nāvindakī gandhabbo aggivesso, ye samaṇe rāmaputte abhippasannā, samaṇe ca pana rāmaputte evarūpaṃ paramanipaccakāraṃ karonti, yadidaṃ abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikamman'ti.

18250.meaning1: (gram) letter o; 8th letter of the alphabet; guttural-labial vowel

examples.text: a kavagga hā kaṇṭhajā, i cavagga yā tālujā, u pavaggā oṭṭhajā, ṭavagga ra ḷā muddhajā, tavagga la sā dantajā, e kaṇṭhatālujo, o kaṇṭh'oṭṭhajo, vo dant'oṭṭhajo.

18251.meaning1: (gram) vuddhi form of the letters u and ū

examples.text: 513, 435. o ava sare.
te o e'icc'ete āva āy'ādese pāpuṇanti kārite. lāveti, nāyeti. yogavibhāgena aññasmim'pi ekārassa āy'ādeso hoti. gāyati, gāyanti.

18252.meaning1: (gram) o; conjugational sign of group 7 tanādigaṇa verbs

examples.text: 451, 520. tanādito o yirā.
tanu'icc'evam'ādito dhātugaṇato o yira'icc'ete paccayā honti kattari. tanoti, tanohi, karoti, karohi, kayirati, kayirāhi.
āneñjapaṭisaṃyuttāya ca pana kathāya kacchamānāya na sussūsati, na sotaṃ odahati, na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhāpeti, na ca taṃ purisaṃ bhajati, na ca tena vittiṃ āpajjati.
hoti kho so, āvuso, samayo yaṃ mahāsamudde yojanasatikāni'pi udakāni ogacchanti, dviyojanasatikāni'pi udakāni ogacchanti, tiyojanasatikāni'pi udakāni ogacchanti
okaṃ pahāya aniketasārī, gāme akubbaṃ muni santhavāni, kāmehi ritto apurekkharāno, kathaṃ na viggayha janena kayirā.
rūpadhātu kho, gahapati, viññāṇassa oko. rūpadhātu-rāgavinibandhañ'ca pana viññāṇaṃ, okasārī'ti vuccati.

18255.synonym: ambu, uda, udaka, oda, odaka, ka, jala, toya, daka, ninnaga, vāri, salila

examples.text: vārijo'va thale khitto, okam'okata'ubbhato, pariphandat'idaṃ cittaṃ, māradheyyaṃ pahātave.

18256.meaning1: tame animal; domesticated animal; house pet
18256.commentary: (MNa) odaheyya okacaran'ti tesaṃ oke caramānaṃ viya ekaṃ dīpakamigaṃ ekasmiṃ ṭhāne ṭhapeyya.

examples.text: so yv'āssa maggo khemo sovatthiko pītigamanīyo taṃ maggaṃ pidaheyya, vivareyya kummaggaṃ, odaheyya okacaraṃ, ṭhapeyya okacārikaṃ.

18257.meaning1: tame female animal; domesticated female animal; house pet

examples.text: iti kho, bhikkhave, vivaṭo mayā khemo maggo sovatthiko pītigamanīyo, pihito kummaggo, ūhato okacaro, nāsitā okacārikā. yaṃ, bhikkhave, satthārā karaṇīyaṃ sāvakānaṃ hit'esinā anukampakena anukampaṃ upādāya, kataṃ vo taṃ mayā.

18258.meaning2: leaving home, abandoning a house; without resort

examples.text: taṃ maṃ tato satthavāho, ussannāya vipulāya vaḍḍhiyā, okaḍḍhati vilapantiṃ, acchinditvā kulagharasmā.

18260.meaning1: cuts off; carves off; saws off

examples.text: vuttaṃ kho pan'etaṃ bhagavatā kakac'ūpam'ovāde, ubhatodaṇḍakena ce'pi, bhikkhave, kakacena corā ocarakā aṅgam'aṅgāni okanteyyuṃ, tatrā'pi yo mano padūseyya na me so tena sāsanakaro'ti.

18263.meaning1: could be possible (for); believable; likely (for); (comm) is trustworthy (for)

examples.text: okappaniyam'etaṃ bhoto gotamassa yathā taṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa.

18265.meaning1: suspects (of); has a hunch (about); considers possible

examples.text: yathārūpe anāsane nisinnaṃ yathārūpe agocare carantaṃ yathārūpe pāpake mitte bhajantaṃ viññū sabrahmacārī pāpakesu ṭhānesu okappeyyuṃ, so tañ'ca anāsanaṃ tañ'ca agocaraṃ te ca pāpake mitte paṭisaṅkhā yoniso parivajjeti
uyyuñjanti satīmanto, na nikete ramanti te, haṃsā'va pallalaṃ hitvā, okam'okaṃ jahanti te.

18268.notes: Sanskrit Udānavarga 31 (Cittavarga) has okād oghāt, which is abl sg of oka + ogha 'from home from stream'. Pāli equivalent would be okamoghato.

examples.text: vārijo'va thale khitto, okam'okata'ubbhato, pariphandat'idaṃ cittaṃ, māradheyyaṃ pahātave.

18269.meaning2: from its home, water; from a watery home

18270.grammar: abs of caus of ava √kamp, caus, trans (+acc)

examples.text: evaṃ vutte daṇḍapāṇi sakko sīsaṃ okampetvā, jivhaṃ nillāḷetvā, tivisākhaṃ nalāṭikaṃ nalāṭe vuṭṭhāpetvā daṇḍam'olubbha pakkāmi.
evaṃ vutte, bhikkhave, upako ājīvako hupeyya'p'āvuso'ti vatvā sīsaṃ okampetvā ummaggaṃ gahetvā pakkāmi.
rūpadhātu kho, gahapati, viññāṇassa oko. rūpadhātu-rāgavinibandhañ'ca pana viññāṇaṃ, okasārī'ti vuccati.
evam'eva kho ahaṃ, bhikkhave, addasaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṃkilesaṃ, kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ nekkhamme ānisaṃsaṃ vodānapakkhaṃ.
atha kho bhagavā brahm'āyussa brāhmaṇassa anupubbiṃ kathaṃ kathesi, seyyath'idaṃ, dānakathaṃ, sīlakathaṃ, saggakathaṃ, kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṃkilesaṃ nekkhamme ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi.

18274.meaning1: (gram) letter o; 8th letter of the alphabet; guttural-labial vowel

examples.text: 511, 521. uttam'okāro.

18275.meaning1: (gram) vuddhi form of the letters u and ū

examples.text: okārassa dhātv'antassa sare pare av'ādeso hoti. cavati. bhavati. o'ti kim'atthaṃ? jayati.
tattha akkharesu okār'antā aṭṭha sarā nāma.

18277.meaning1: (gram) o suffix; conjugational sign of group 7 tanādigaṇa verbs

examples.text: okārapaccayo uttam'āpajjate vā. kurute, karoti. okāro'ti kim'atthaṃ? hoti.

18278.meaning1: space; open space; gap; opening; (comm) meditation

examples.text: acchariyaṃ, āvuso, abbhutaṃ, āvuso! yāvañ'c'idaṃ tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sambādhe okās'ādhigamo anubuddho sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokaparidevānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthaṅ'gamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya.
sambādhe vata okāsaṃ, avindi bhūrimedhaso, yo jhānam'abujjhi buddho, paṭilīnanisabho munī'ti.

18279.commentary: (ANa) okāso na paññāyati sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāyā'ti yasmā ca evaṃ sante tena kamm'āyūhanañ'c'eva vipāk'ānubhavanā ca hoti, tasmā hetunā nayena vaṭṭadukkhassa antakiriyāya okāso na paññāyati nāma.

examples.text: yo, bhikkhave, evaṃ vadeyya, yathā yath'āyaṃ puriso kammaṃ karoti tathā tathā taṃ paṭisaṃvediyatī'ti, evaṃ santaṃ, bhikkhave, brahmacariyavāso na hoti, okāso na paññāyati sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāya.
adaṃsu te mam'okāsaṃ, sodhetuṃ añjasaṃ tadā, buddho buddho'ti cintento, maggaṃ sodhem'ahaṃ tadā.

sappi'ādīni bhesajjāni aṭṭhavidhāni pānakāni vatthacchādanamālāgandh'ādīni vā ādāya vihāraṃ gantvā tāni datvā divāṭṭhānaṃ pavisitvā okāsaṃ kāretvā pañhaṃ pucchati. evañ'hi vattaṃ ñatvā pucchanto paṭipadāya saṇṭhāti nāma.

18281.meaning1: permit me!; excuse me!; with your permission!

examples.text: okāsa! sammajjanī, sammajjanakaraṇaṃ kataṃ kiṃ?
examples.source: VIN PAT PK saṅghuposatha pubbakaraṇādi vidhi

examples.text: yaṃ vat'āhaṃ aññesu samaṇabrāhmaṇesu okāsakammamattam'pi n'ālatthaṃ taṃ me idaṃ samaṇena gotamena okāsakammaṃ katan'ti. attamano pamudito udaggo pītisomanassajāto bhagavantaṃ pañhaṃ apucchi.
yaṃ vat'āhaṃ aññesu samaṇabrāhmaṇesu okāsakammamattam'pi n'ālatthaṃ taṃ me idaṃ samaṇena gotamena okāsakammaṃ katan'ti. attamano pamudito udaggo pītisomanassajāto bhagavantaṃ pañhaṃ apucchi.

18286.meaning1: taking up space; filling up room
18286.commentary: (ANa) okāsapharaṇo'ti okāsaṃ pharitvā aññesaṃ sambādhaṃ katvā ṭhānena okāsapharaṇo.

examples.text: pañcahi, bhikkhave, aṅgehi samannāgato rañño nāgo bhatt'ādako ca hoti okāsapharaṇo ca laṇḍasāraṇo ca salākaggāhī ca rañño nāgo'tv'eva saṅkhaṃ gacchati. katamehi pañcahi?

18287.grammar: aor of okāsaṃ karoti, comp vb (+dat)
18287.meaning1: made space (for); made room (for); gave way (to)
18287.commentary: (MNa) oramiya okāsamakāsī'ti vegena uṭṭhāya dvidhā bhijjitvā okāsam'akāsi.

examples.text: disvāna oramiya okāsam'akāsi yathā taṃ ñātassa yasassino.

18288.meaning1: existence of occasion; presence of opportunity (to)

18290.meaning1: grants permission; gives an opportunity; gives consent (to)

examples.text: puccheyyāma mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ channaṃ kañci'd'eva desaṃ, sace āyasmā channo okāsaṃ karoti pañhassa veyyākaraṇāyā'ti. pucch'āvuso sāriputta, sutvā vedissāmā'ti.
ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho saccako nigaṇṭhaputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, puccheyy'āhaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ kiñci'd'eva desaṃ, sace me bhavaṃ gotamo okāsaṃ karoti pañhassa veyyākaraṇāyā'ti.

18291.meaning2: causes to give an opportunity; obtains consent; gains permission (especially to speak)

18292.meaning2: causes to give an opportunity; obtains consent; gains permission (especially to speak)

18293.meaning1: having gained permission; having been given consent (to)

18294.meaning1: asks for the opportunity; requests permission (to)

examples.text: añña'd'atthu samaṇaṃ'y'eva gotamaṃ okāsaṃ yācanti agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjāya.

18295.meaning1: finding of space; discovery of room

examples.text: acchariyaṃ, āvuso, abbhutaṃ, āvuso! yāvañ'c'idaṃ tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sambādhe okās'ādhigamo anubuddho sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokaparidevānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthaṅ'gamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya.

18296.meaning1: absence of occasion; lack of opportunity (to)

18297.meaning1: places in the open; makes visible; (comm) scatters around

examples.text: sādhu me, bhante, ayyo mahako uttarimanussadhammaṃ iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ dassetū'ti. tena hi tvaṃ, gahapati, ālinde uttar'āsaṅgaṃ paññapetvā tiṇakalāpaṃ okāsehī'ti.

18298.meaning1: placed in the open; made visible; (comm) scattered around

examples.text: evaṃ, bhante'ti kho citto gahapati āyasmato mahakassa paṭissutvā ālinde uttar'āsaṅgaṃ paññapetvā tiṇakalāpaṃ okāsesi.
vātavuṭṭhisamayo nāma bhikkhū sarajena vātena okiṇṇā honti, dve vā tīṇi vā udakaphusitāni kāye patitāni honti, vātavuṭṭhisamayo'ti nahāyitabbaṃ.
